project.name: ZZW Code Teacher 客户端
project.designRead: coding education client / developers & learners / calm premium trust / medium density / avoid neon tech hero

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: Apple-style sidebar navigation with icon + label, dark background (#0a0a0a), rounded items, active state uses brand blue tint
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: Pinguo Blue #0066cc as primary CTA and active states, no secondary brand hue
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: DM Sans for all UI and display, JetBrains Mono for code blocks and technical details
sharedProjectShellContract.radiusScale: 1.2rem global, pill buttons, rounded cards, tight radius for small controls
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: 1px border-first, whisper-light shadows at rest (0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)), deeper elevation on hover/overlay
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: pill-shaped primary buttons, brand blue fill, white text, rounded secondary buttons with border
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: left-aligned content, centered hero areas, consistent 16/24/32/48 spacing rhythm

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Apple-inspired premium restraint: Pinguo Blue #0066cc primary, Space Black #0a0a0a dark surfaces, Silver Mist #f5f5f7 light backgrounds, DM Sans typography, 1.2rem radius, whisper shadows

iconAssets.coloringRule: currentColor by default; override with Library token when needed

pages.title: 主界面
pages.businessScenario: main dashboard showing course categories, learning progress, and recommended courses
pages.visualNorthStar: Calm, focused learning dashboard — sidebar nav + main content with course cards arranged in a clean grid
pages.compositionPattern: sidebar + content-area layout, hero welcome section, category chip row, course card grid, progress summary
continuityAnchors: sidebar navigation with dark background and brand blue active state
DM Sans typography with 1.2rem card radius and whisper shadows

pages.title: 课程详情
pages.businessScenario: single course detail view with course description, chapter list, and code preview
pages.visualNorthStar: Editorial course page — split layout with course hero and chapter sidebar
pages.compositionPattern: course hero header, info-action dual-column, chapter list with progress indicators
continuityAnchors: sidebar navigation with dark background and brand blue active state
DM Sans typography with 1.2rem card radius and whisper shadows

pages.title: 代码练习
pages.businessScenario: interactive code practice environment with editor, problem description, and output panel
pages.visualNorthStar: IDE-inspired coding environment — dark code editor panel, clean task sidebar, focused split layout

continuityAnchors: sidebar navigation with dark background and brand blue active state
DM Sans typography with 1.2rem card radius and whisper shadows
